verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a built-in test framework with LLM judges and agent simulations that evaluate scripted or LLM-driven test conversations. That is pre-deployment testing, not automatic AI review of real calls covering quality scoring, failure flagging and resolution analysis. Nothing in the pack shows post-call analytics on production calls, and a community report notes users lacked per-call visibility.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically
